findings.finding: The Q2 call on 2026-09-11 is a 'pre-recorded conference call and webcast' — the first pre-recorded RENT earnings call in at least four quarters; the Q2 FY25 (2025-08-25), Q4 FY25 (2026-03-24) and Q1 FY26 (2026-05-19) announcements all said 'conference call and live webcast', so management has removed live analyst Q&A for this print while the company is run by an interim CEO.

RENT borrowed a $10,000,000 incremental term loan on 2026-09-01 'for working capital and other general corporate purposes' — ten days before the print and after the 2026-07-31 quarter end — even though the 10-Q states the minimum liquidity covenant was PERMANENTLY REMOVED by the First Amendment of 2026-01-28 and the Second Amendment of 2026-04-01 already lets it PIK interest until 2027-05-03; with no covenant to cure and no cash interest to service, the only reason left to take sponsor money is operating cash, which implies a Q2 cash balance far below the $37.1m at 2026-04-30 and the $43.6m at 2025-07-31.
findings.source_date: 2026-09-01 (Third Amendment to Amended and Restated Credit Agreement, dated 2026-09-01; NOT the Oct 2025 A&R, the Jan 2026 First Amendment or the Apr 2026 Second Amendment)

findings.finding: On 2026-09-03 RENT signed a $9,000,000 Stipulation and Agreement of Settlement of the November 2022 IPO securities class action — $6m cash plus $3m in Class A stock, with insurers paying ~$2.9m and the company ~$3.1m — eight days before the print and five weeks after the 2026-07-31 balance sheet date, so under recognised-subsequent-event treatment the charge lands in the Q2 GAAP numbers being reported on 2026-09-11, and the stock component is ~1.1m new shares (~3.3%) on a 33.59m share count.

FY26 guidance cuts rental product acquired to $45-50m from $74.9m in FY25 — a ~35% reduction in the inventory that is the product — while ending Active Subscriber growth has already decelerated from ~+20% y/y in Q4 FY25 to +5.8% y/y in Q1 FY26 (155,692), and the dominant live customer complaint is that the assortment is empty ('tiny inventory with items rarely available for rent', 'items marked available now that aren't available in any size').
